patterns.title: Look-alike terms
patterns.text: Check sheet vs checklist, payback vs time value of money, mitigate vs avoid. Define both terms before picking.

patterns.title: Ignoring the scenario's giveaway line
patterns.text: 'Selected without evaluation' means sacred cow. 'Willing to eliminate an interface' means scope reduction. 'Rewards and recognition' means reinforce. The answer is usually written into the scenario.

patterns.title: Picking an option that isn't in the category
patterns.text: 'Upgrading the change', 'Incentives' as a constraint, 'Risk process group'. Eliminate anything that isn't on the official list first.

patterns.title: Partial paths and wrong order
patterns.text: Critical path must be a complete path. The schedule starts at the first WBS activity, and the schedule follows the bottom-up estimates.

note: From C722 - Pre-Assessment 1 Fix-It Guide ('Patterns across your misses')
